jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original premium fantasy game weapon MATERIAL TEXTURE swatch for ruidium weapons. Square, full bleed, flat neutral material surface without object silhouette or backdrop. Weathered dull rust-brown weapon steel with dense embedded crimson translucent crystal veins and small irregular red crystalline inclusions, fine rough tactile rust beside polished crystal facets, restrained burgundy/red specular reflections, deep copper shadows and muted graphite highlights. The veins are mineral crystals inside the crafted surface, not molten lava, no fire, no glowing orange cracks. Entirely distinct from silver filigree, graphite adamantine angular engravings, gold infernal etchings and blue magical steel. Detailed painterly realism, premium fantasy inventory artwork, fine craftsmanship; uniform medium and small-scale decorative coverage suitable for masking within many complete weapon silhouettes. No center medallion, text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, isolated objects, complete weapon, armor, character, border, heavy vignette, cast shadow, smoke, flames, glowing aura or checkerboard. Create one unmistakable original mineral finish.
